facts: Product page identifies a women's 100% organic cotton regular-fit T-shirt.
The product lists a round neck, half sleeves, solid knit fabric, pull-on opening and straight hem.
Care instructions say machine wash cold, dark colours separately, no bleach, remove promptly and dry in shade.
Cottonworld's voice is calm, warm, plain and reassuring.
Brand guidance says life comes first and clothing enters as quiet, practical support.
Cottonworld's merchandising taxonomy includes women's T-shirts, tops, pants, travel and natural-fabric categories.
